banker_outreach: Hi Priya, Marcus Bellweather (NMLS: 2125037) with Rocket Mortgage (NMLS: 3030). You're a current client, and I noticed you have equity built up in your home. I can help you access that value to simplify expenses or reach your goals. It's quick and easy-reply when you're ready to explore your options!
client_inbound: What rate could I get? My current one is pretty high. Also, Marcus, just yesterday I submitted paperwork to update equity based on a recent large principle payment. As such we're going to need to update your file on the equity value, which should now be at $136.5K. Thank you Marcus, God bless!

nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and ready to move on a refi — the play is to remove friction and advance directly to application, not re-sell or interrogate them with discovery questions.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to whatever they asked, anchoring on their real numbers
  - Reference their current 6.88% rate and $1,971/mo P&I payment by name — no generic opener
  - Do not open with 'tell me more about your goals' or any re-pitch of refi benefits they already know

- Move straight to the soft credit pull / application in the same message
  - Something like: 'Based on your $298,983 balance at 6.88%, I can pull today's numbers for you with no impact to your credit — here's the link to get started: [e-sign/app link]'
  - Do NOT stack on discovery questions before offering this step

- If you need to show a rate gap, compute the actual achievable rate and monthly savings from today's pricing before sending — do not state a savings figure you haven't verified
  - Present real dollar delta vs. their $1,971/mo once you have a live rate to quote

- Keep the message short: one direct answer, one clear next step, one link or call-to-action
  - Avoid multi-paragraph responses or bullet-point value lists — this client has already bought in
